notes: Round 1: bruising was near zero (median pressure 21-55 kPa, far under the 40-110 kPa threshold) while slip was 7-47% and collision 16-32%. So spend the pressure headroom on grip force (5-8 N), and cut collisions with 3 fingers and shorter length where slip allows. Best so far was 22 mm wide, 35 mm long, 6 N, 4 fingers (J 0.506, collision 0.32).
